_readme: Real (digit-redacted) SMS alerts, one per shape. The parser (src/core/smsParser.ts) is validated against every entry by src/core/__tests__/smsParser.test.ts. `expect: null` means the parser must NOT treat that text as a money movement (OTP, promo, balance-only). After editing, run `yarn test` — any sample whose `expect` no longer matches fails loudly and tells you what to fix.

_fields.source: who sent it (bank name / utility) — for your reference only
_fields.raw: the SMS text as received (newlines allowed)
_fields.expect: what the parser must extract, or null if it must be ignored
_fields.expect.kind: purchase | atm | transfer_out | transfer_in | loan_payment | utility | reversal | bank_charge | other
_fields.expect.account: identifying digits/mask the message referenced — used to match your cards
